== Biography ==
Thomas Glasgow was born before 15 June 1715, when he was baptized at Edinburgh, Midlothian, Scotland. The parish entry names his father as [[Glasgow-3285|Thomas Glasgow]], a baxter and indweller.<ref name="FMP">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929'', Thomas Glasgow, baptism 15 June 1715, Edinburgh, father Thomas Glasgow, “Baxter Indweller,” OPR 685_1/16, item 3, page 53; record SCOT/OPR/BAP/0606238; [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F0606238&tab=this transcript], accessed 4 September 2026.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3285]] is assessed at 96% (proved). Thomas’s 1715 transcript names Thomas, baxter and indweller of Edinburgh; the maintained 1699 baxter apprenticeship gives the attached father a specific craft and locality fit. The 1684-child/apprentice identity is an inference, while biography’s alternative Thomas/Jean pair is unsupported by this entry.

Existing child-to-father link assessed from held public evidence; The baxter craft supports 1699 apprentice to 1715 father; identity with the 1684 baptism is maintained but not literally repeated.

Next useful test: Compare baxters’ incorporation or marriage records to bridge the apprentice to the 1715 father.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F0606238&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929: Thomas Glasgow, 15 Jun 1715, record SCOT/OPR/BAP/0606238]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


=== Current evidence assessment ===

The baptism names only Thomas's father. It supports a confident father relationship to Thomas Glasgow (Glasgow-3285), whose own biography identifies this son from the same baptism. It does not identify a mother. [[Glasgow-1242|Thomas Glasgow]] and [[Duncan-16665|Jean Duncan]] appeared as parents in the captured narrative, but that claim conflicts with the structured father and is not supported by this record.
